stories.title: The Kasper Brothers (FKA The Creeds) Make Surprise AEW Debut at Full Gear
stories.tldr: Just one week after their WWE departures, former Creed Brothers Julius and Brutus debuted at AEW Full Gear 2026 under their real names as Jacob and Drew Kasper. The duo shocked fans by launching a vicious attack on AEW World Tag Team Champions The Young Bucks and number one contenders the Motor City Machine Guns. They then aligned themselves with FTR and their former NXT manager Stokely Hathaway. AEW President Tony Khan officially confirmed their signing shortly after the event.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland & New Level Win AEW Trios Titles in Texas Death Match at Full Gear
stories.tldr: At AEW Full Gear 2026 in Phoenix, Arizona, Swerve Strickland and The New Level defeated Hangman Adam Page and Brodido in a brutal and bloody Texas Death Match to recapture the AEW World Trios Championships. The chaotic contest featured an extreme assortment of weapons, including barbed wire tables, thumbtacks, staple guns, glass panes, and an explosive Power Glove. The finish saw Strickland counter a Buckshot Lariat with a steel chair before laying out Page with a House Call to secure the triple knockout victory, adding another violent chapter to their championship rivalry.

stories.title: Kris Statlander and Harley Cameron Win AEW Women's Tag Team Championship at Full Gear
stories.tldr: At AEW Full Gear on November 14, 2026, Kris Statlander and Harley Cameron, known as Wrathlander, defeated Jamie Hayter and Alex Windsor to capture the AEW Women's World Tag Team Championships. After a comedic pre-match segment featuring Billy Gunn and Tony Khan, the challengers overcame the champions in a hard-fought battle. The decisive moment occurred when Cameron pulled Hayter out of the ring to disrupt their finishing sequence, allowing Statlander to hit Saturday Night Fever on Windsor for the pinfall. The victory brought historic milestones, making Cameron a two-time tag champion and Statlander an AEW Triple Crown winner.

stories.title: The Cut Defeats Death Riders in Anarchy in the Arena Match at Full Gear
stories.tldr: At AEW Full Gear 2026, The Cut secured a major victory over the combined forces of The Death Riders and The Conglomeration in a chaotic Anarchy in the Arena match. The brutal bout featured broken glass, a flaming table, and numerous surprise appearances including the Phoenix Suns mascot, Mercedes Mone, CMLL star Kemalito, and a returning Claudio Castagnoli. The finish saw Jay White connect with a Blade Runner on Jon Moxley over shattered glass to score the decisive pinfall.

stories.title: Kazuchika Okada Defeats Adam Copeland to Retain AEW International Championship at Full Gear
stories.tldr: Kazuchika Okada successfully defended his AEW International Championship against pro wrestling veteran Adam Copeland in a brutal opening match at AEW Full Gear. The nearly 19-minute encounter featured fierce action, including both icons mocking each other's signature moves and taunts. Okada ultimately secured the victory by hitting an Impaler DDT on the exposed ringside floor followed by a devastating Rainmaker. For good measure, the champion delivered one final Rainmaker to Copeland after the match concluded.

stories.title: Tony Khan to Announce AEW Continental Classic Entrants During Monday Night Football
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan has announced that the 2026 Continental Classic tournament will kick off on the November 18 episode of AEW Dynamite in Denver, Colorado. To reveal the 12 competitors divided into the Blue and Gold leagues, Khan and Tony Schiavone will co-host a special selection show airing on AEW social media channels during halftime of Monday Night Football on November 16. Khan noted that the final participants will depend on evaluating wrestler health following the Full Gear pay-per-view, with the tournament culminating in the semi-finals and finals at AEW Worlds End on December 19.

stories.title: Tony Khan Confirms Persephone Signed to Multi-Year AEW Deal
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan announced during the Full Gear post-show press conference that CMLL standout Persephone is signed to a multi-year agreement, securing her future with both promotions well beyond 2026. The reigning CMLL World Women’s Championship holder previously signed a dual contract in January 2026, leading to earlier speculation about her contract expiration and unfounded rumors regarding WWE interest. Currently aligned with Britt Baker and a former TBS Champion, Persephone competed in a four-way match for the TBS title at Full Gear before Khan officially clarified her long-term status.

stories.title: AEW Full Gear Post-Show Media Scrum
stories.tldr: Following the AEW Full Gear pay-per-view in Phoenix, Arizona, company president Tony Khan and top wrestling stars gathered for the post-show media scrum. The event closed with Will Ospreay successfully defending the AEW world championship against Kyle Fletcher, followed by a shocking appearance by MJF. The packed 12-match card also featured title changes, major returns, and shocking debuts that provided plenty of talking points for the post-show press conference.

stories.title: Samoa Joe vs. Jack Perry Set for AEW Dynamite Following Pre-Show Brawl
stories.tldr: Jack Perry provoked Samoa Joe during the AEW Full Gear Tailgate Brawl by defeating The Beast Mortos, using Joe's signature Muscle Buster, and calling him out on camera after travel issues prevented Joe from attending the pay-per-view. In response, Joe delivered a chilling video warning rejecting Perry's desire for a handshake and promising to strangle him unconscious. AEW has now officially booked a singles match between Samoa Joe and Jack Perry for the post-Full Gear episode of AEW Dynamite. Additionally, the upcoming episode will feature the start of the 2026 Continental Classic tournament, with participants being revealed on November 16th.

stories.title: AEW Unveils Redesigned World Trios Belts Featuring Tribute to PAC
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling has unveiled a redesigned look for its World Trios Championship belts that includes a heartfelt tribute to the late Benjamin Satterley, also known as PAC. The updated titles feature gold plates, black leather straps, an engraved side plate, and a memorial inscription on the back reading In Memory of Benjamin Satterley 1986-2026. As a two-time champion who helped establish the division through his work with Death Triangle and the Death Riders, PAC's legacy will now remain permanently tied to the championships.

stories.title: Fan Accidentally Kicked in Face by MJF at AEW Full Gear
stories.tldr: MJF made a shocking return at AEW Full Gear by attacking Will Ospreay after his match against Kyle Fletcher. While making his hasty exit by jumping over the ringside barricade, MJF accidentally kicked a female fan directly in the face. Fortunately, sources within AEW reported that the fan was completely fine and even laughed the situation off. This allowed everyone to shift their focus back to the storyline as MJF officially set his sights on the AEW World Championship.

stories.title: AEW Full Gear 2026 Review and Analysis
stories.tldr: AEW Full Gear 2026 delivered an action-packed event featuring a Texas Death match, MJF's return to attack the world champion, and Anarchy in the Arena. In a detailed review of the card, the women's tag team championship match was heavily criticized for poor build, bad placement, and a rushed title change. Conversely, the Young Bucks earned high praise for their phenomenal tag team title match utilizing a classic David versus Goliath storytelling formula.

stories.title: MJF Announced to Appear on Post-Full Gear AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: Following a dramatic return at the Full Gear pay-per-view, former AEW World Champion MJF is scheduled to appear on the upcoming episode of Dynamite. MJF shocked the wrestling world by launching a surprise attack on AEW World Champion Will Ospreay after Ospreay successfully defended his title against Kyle Fletcher. AEW President Tony Khan later confirmed during the post-show media scrum that MJF will address his shocking actions live on television. The heavily anticipated appearance highlights an action-packed lineup for the upcoming show, which also features the start of the Continental Classic tournament and a singles match between Samoa Joe and Jack Perry.

stories.title: Bandido Shows Off Head Wound After Texas Death Match
stories.tldr: Bandido suffered a nasty head wound requiring stitches after participating in a brutal Texas Death Match at AEW Full Gear. He shared a graphic photo on Twitter showcasing the deep cut he sustained during the chaotic championship bout. Bandido, alongside teammates Hangman Page and Brody King, ultimately lost their World Trios Championships to Swerve Strickland, Kofi Kingston, and Austin Creed. Despite losing the titles and enduring severe punishment from various weapons, Bandido provided undeniable photographic proof of the match's violent nature.

stories.title: Potential Second Entrant Declares Intentions for AEW Continental Classic
stories.tldr: Following his AEW National Championship loss to Ilja Dragunov at Full Gear, Tommaso Ciampa has officially declared his intent to enter the upcoming AEW Continental Classic tournament. Ciampa is looking to rebound from his short one-week title reign and prove his dominance against any opponent in the grueling competition. He joins reigning Continental Champion Jon Moxley as the tournament field takes shape ahead of Monday's official bracket reveal on YouTube. The 12 man tournament kicks off this Wednesday on Dynamite and will culminate next month with the semifinals and finals at the World's End pay per view.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Full Gear Fallout Preview
stories.tldr: AEW is presenting its Full Gear fallout edition of Dynamite this Wednesday live from Denver, Colorado. The card is highlighted by a freshly booked match between Jack Perry and Samoa Joe, which was put together after flight cancellations prevented Joe from appearing at the recent Tailgate Brawl pre-show. Additionally, the episode will feature the official kickoff of the Continental Classic tournament and an appearance by MJF to address his shocking attack on Will Ospreay at the conclusion of Full Gear.

stories.title: Backstage Update on Kairi's Status Ahead of Full Gear
stories.tldr: Former WWE and STARDOM star Kairi remains a free agent following her departure from the company in April. Although she recently appeared on Chris Jericho's wrestling cruise and met with Tony Khan, she has not yet signed a contract and currently lacks a US work visa. Meanwhile, fellow free agent Sheamus has not been spotted backstage at Full Gear despite widespread speculation linking him to AEW.

stories.title: Val Venis Demonstrates Outside Full Gear Venue in Phoenix
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Val Venis, whose real name is Sean Morley, staged a protest outside the venue hosting AEW Full Gear 2026 in Phoenix, Arizona. Holding a provocative anti-abortion sign, Morley live-streamed his demonstration and engaged with passing wrestling fans. While one fan gestured obscenely toward him, others stopped to take pictures and heard his controversial statistical argument linking abortion rates to wrestling demographics.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher Discusses Rapid Rise as Singles Star
stories.tldr: AEW star Kyle Fletcher recently admitted that his rapid ascent as a singles competitor happened much faster than he originally anticipated. After gaining prominence in New Japan Pro-Wrestling as part of Aussie Open, Fletcher transitioned into a successful singles run following his partner Mark Davis's injury in late 2023. Now a fixture in the singles division with reigns as both TNT and International Champion, Fletcher is preparing to challenge Will Ospreay for the AEW World Championship.

stories.title: AEW Arranges Private Charters Amid Flight Disruptions Ahead of Full Gear
stories.tldr: Following the nationwide FAA flight groundings, AEW President Tony Khan dispatched three private charter planes to hub locations to ensure stranded talent reached Phoenix for Full Gear. While these emergency flights successfully preserved the entire main pay-per-view card, minor adjustments were required for the Tailgate Brawl pre-show. Most notably, Maya World missed the event due to travel delays, prompting a last-minute change to the TBS Championship match.

stories.title: MJF Makes Surprise Return at Full Gear After Will Ospreay Defeats Kyle Fletcher
stories.tldr: MJF made a surprise return at AEW Full Gear by attacking World Champion Will Ospreay right after his successful title defense against Kyle Fletcher. The returning star laid out Ospreay with his Triple B belt and unmasked, officially kicking off his promised pursuit of the championship. He later posted a short message online reminding fans that he had warned them of his target.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov Defeats Tommaso Ciampa for AEW National Championship at Full Gear
stories.tldr: Ilja Dragunov defeated Tommaso Ciampa at Full Gear to capture the AEW National Championship, ending Ciampa's brief seven-day reign. The brutal, hard-hitting match featured heavy limb targeting, high-impact spots on the steel steps, and a dramatic finish sealed with consecutive D-Bombs. Following the loss, a frustrated Ciampa immediately shifted his focus toward entering the upcoming Continental Classic. Dragunov remains undefeated since his recent debut and is already being positioned as a fighting champion.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné Retains Women's World Title Against Marina Shafir at Full Gear
stories.tldr: At Full Gear, Mercedes Mone successfully defended her AEW Women's World Championship against a fiercely dominant Marina Shafir. Shafir came agonizingly close to winning, even making the champion tap out outside the ring and later reversing a Brutalizer submission. Ultimately, Mone narrowly escaped with her title intact by stealing a tainted pinfall using the ropes for leverage. Following the controversial finish, the champion quickly fled the scene to celebrate her escape.

stories.title: Big Boom AJ Extends Undefeated Streak at AEW Full Gear
stories.tldr: The Costco Guys arrived at Full Gear ready for action alongside QT Marshall to face members of the Don Callis Family. Big Boom AJ successfully extended his undefeated streak to 8-0 during the event. The viral star secured another pre-show victory after delivering his signature Powerboom in a chaotic multi-man tag team match.

stories.title: AEW Full Gear 2026 Betting Odds Update
stories.tldr: Major betting odds movements have hit the card for AEW Full Gear 2026. While Will Ospreay saw his massive lead narrow against Kyle Fletcher, Mercedes Moné and Queen Aminata saw their respective favorite statuses solidify. Meanwhile, the AEW World Trios Championship Texas Death Match has tightened up dramatically into nearly a pick-em scenario.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher Comments on Adam Copeland's Pending Retirement
stories.tldr: AEW star Kyle Fletcher recently shared his personal reflections on Adam Copeland approaching his eventual retirement. Fletcher recalled growing up as a fan of the veteran and witnessing both his past retirement and emotional return. Having already pinned Copeland in past competition, Fletcher now hopes for one final match to prove his superiority before the icon hangs up his boots for good.

stories.title: AEW Full Gear travel impacted as flight groundings leave wrestlers stranded
stories.tldr: A nationwide FAA ground stop caused by an air traffic control telecommunications outage left several AEW wrestlers stranded ahead of Full Gear 2026 in Phoenix, Arizona. While many talent members had already traveled directly from the previous week's tapings, the sudden shutdown sparked major concern over potential delays and card changes. Fortunately, the ground stop was eventually lifted, and reports indicate that everyone scheduled for the pay-per-view is now expected to make it to the event. The travel chaos also threatened other wrestling promotions like TNA and WWE, though those events largely avoided major disruptions.

stories.title: AEW's Bobby Lashley wins 4th Rope Heavyweight Championship
stories.tldr: AEW star Bobby Lashley captured the 4th Rope Heavyweight Championship at the Heelmatic event in New York by defeating Joe Alonzo in a quick two-minute squash match. The title change was orchestrated by 4th Rope General Manager MVP, who initially handed the vacant belt to Alonzo before forcing him to defend it immediately against Lashley. This victory marks Lashley's second active singles championship outside of AEW, as he also holds the ACW World Championship.

stories.title: AEW Collision viewership for November 11, 2026
stories.tldr: AEW Collision experienced a significant viewership increase for its November 11, 2026 episode, pulling in 500,000 viewers on TBS. This represents a substantial jump from the previous episode on November 7, which drew 376,000 viewers. The key P18 to 49 demographic also saw strong growth, rising to a 0.12 rating compared to 0.08 the week prior. Additionally, these numbers mark a massive year-over-year improvement of over 128 percent in total viewership compared to mid-November 2025.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite viewership for November 11, 2026
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite on November 11, 2026, drew 742,000 viewers on TBS with a 0.16 rating in the key 18 to 49 demographic, marking a slight decline from the previous week. Despite the week-over-week drop in both total audience and demo rating, the numbers still represent an encouraging year-over-year increase compared to the same week in 2025. These figures exclusively track linear television viewership on TBS and exclude digital or streaming platforms as the promotion builds toward its next major live event.

stories.title: Mercedes Mone reflects on attending Forbes Power Women's Summit
stories.tldr: AEW Women's World Champion Mercedes Mone recently attended the Forbes Power Women's Summit in New York City, bringing her title belt and a nose cast following her appearance at All In. Writing in her Mone Mag newsletter, she described the experience as incredible and a vital opportunity to represent the business and impact of women's professional wrestling among leaders from various industries. Alongside rubbing shoulders with notable figures like Serena Williams and Jennifer Garner, Mone discussed negotiation and her CEO persona with entrepreneur Haley Sacks. Looking ahead, Mone is set to defend her championship against Marina Shafir at AEW Full Gear on November 14 in Phoenix.

stories.title: Ricochet claims 97 percent of AEW locker room wants the best for the company
stories.tldr: Ricochet recently praised the All Elite Wrestling locker room for its strong sense of unity and shared ambition as the company celebrates its seventh year. Despite facing tragic losses and natural egos, he believes that the vast majority of the talent is entirely dedicated to making the promotion as successful as possible. He compares this positive environment to the camaraderie found on the independent circuit years ago. Furthermore, this resilient group is currently preparing to deliver a major show as the company approaches its upcoming Full Gear pay-per-view event.

stories.title: Stevie Richards criticizes crowd reaction to Darby Allin's Blood & Guts cage fall
stories.tldr: Former wrestling star Stevie Richards recently discussed Darby Allin's dangerous fall from the top of the cage during a Blood and Guts event on his online show. Richards pointed out that the terrifying stunt failed to generate the massive crowd reaction or sustained concern that such a high-risk bump warrants, comparing it unfavorably to Mick Foley's historic Hell in a Cell fall. He noted that many fans remained seated instead of reacting with panic or awe, suggesting the spot suffered from diminished returns due to overexposure. Ultimately, Richards placed the blame not on the audience, but on creative repetition that has desensitized viewers to extreme cage spots.

stories.title: WON Flashback: Hangman Page vs. Kenny Omega at AEW Full Gear 2021
stories.tldr: On November 13 2021, Adam Page defeated Kenny Omega in the main event of AEW Full Gear to win the AEW World Championship in a critically acclaimed match rated five and a half stars by the Wrestling Observer Newsletter. The grueling 25 minute encounter featured heavy outside interference from Don Callis, brutal high risk maneuvers, and tense psychological drama involving The Young Bucks. Ultimately, Page overcame Omega's offense and used two Buckshot Lariats to secure the historic victory and capture the world title.

stories.title: Tony Khan praises Jon Moxley's support for Marina Shafir's growth
stories.tldr: Tony Khan is praising Marina Shafir's hard work ahead of her AEW Women's World Championship match against Mercedes Mone at Full Gear. During a recent media call, Khan highlighted how Jon Moxley has consistently gone to bat for Shafir as a mentor and advocate. Khan noted that both he and Moxley are immensely proud of Shafir's in-ring development and dedication to the company.

stories.title: Christian Cage injury recovery update from Tony Khan
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan provided an update on Christian Cage during a media call ahead of Full Gear, stating that the veteran is in the middle of a challenging recovery from severe injuries. Cage suffered a collapsed lung and three broken ribs, with one fractured in three places, during a brutal three-way ladder match at All Out. Although Khan expressed strong optimism that Cage will eventually return to the ring, he was unable to offer a specific timetable for his comeback. During the same media call, Khan also addressed several other topics, including updates on Marcus Mathers, the renaming of Jay White's faction to The Cut, and Claudio Castagnoli's value to the company.

stories.title: AEW forced to make last-minute changes to combined Dynamite/Collision taping
stories.tldr: AEW faced significant logistical challenges and had to scramble to rearrange its combined Dynamite and Collision taping in Utah. The travel complications stemmed from talent returning from Chris Jericho's Rock 'N' Wrestling Rager at Sea cruise, which docked in Miami shortly before the show. Because officials were uncertain who would arrive on time, portions of the crucial Full Gear go-home broadcast were put together entirely on the fly. Despite these last-minute changes, all advertised matches ultimately took place, and the special ran over its scheduled three-hour time slot.

stories.title: Tony Khan discusses early AEW/NJPW relationship and Wrestle Dynasty future
stories.tldr: During the AEW Full Gear media call, Tony Khan opened up about the early cold war between AEW and New Japan Pro-Wrestling during 2019 and 2020 before their relationship blossomed into a strong partnership in 2021. Khan also addressed the future of the multi-promotional event Wrestle Dynasty, suggesting it may not return as a separate show anytime soon. Instead, AEW is sending top stars like Jon Moxley, Kenny Omega, and MJF directly to Wrestle Kingdom to provide the crossover attraction fans expect.

stories.title: Big Boom AJ, Big Justice, and The Rizzler set for AEW Full Gear appearance
stories.tldr: The viral Costco Guys crew featuring Big Boom AJ, Big Justice, and The Rizzler are heading to AEW Full Gear for a special appearance this Saturday in Phoenix. Big Boom AJ and QT Marshall, teaming up as Boom and Doom, issued a challenge on Ring of Honor television to RPG Vice members Trent Beretta and Rocky Romero. The two teams will collide on the Tailgate Brawl pre-show in a rematch from last year's event. This marks AJ's first in-ring action since August, as he looks to protect his undefeated streak in an AEW ring.

stories.title: MJF backstage update regarding expected return to AEW
stories.tldr: Former AEW World Champion MJF is expected to make his return to television very soon following a two-month absence since All In: London in late August. According to backstage reports, creative plans are already in place to insert the top star directly into a major, high-level program. Although an exact return date remains unconfirmed, speculation points toward a potential major storyline as the company approaches upcoming pay-per-view events.

stories.title: Ronda Rousey potential AEW return updates
stories.tldr: Marina Shafir has offered an intriguing update regarding a potential AEW return for Ronda Rousey, refusing to rule out the possibility of her joining the Death Riders. While Rousey previously questioned the time-consuming nature of a full-time wrestling schedule following her surprise appearance at Revolution 2026, Shafir emphasizes that fans should keep an open mind about unfulfilled possibilities. AEW President Tony Khan has previously stated that Rousey would be welcome to compete for the promotion if she chooses to do so.

stories.title: Tony Khan praises former WWE ID star and wants more AEW/ROH appearances
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan has expressed high praise for independent wrestler Marcus Mathers following his recent appearances in Ring of Honor and All Elite Wrestling. Mathers, a former WWE ID prospect who became a free agent in October 2026, was initially recommended by Christopher Daniels. After delivering standout matches against Mark Davis on ROH and Nick Wayne on AEW Collision, Khan admitted he was completely blown away by the young talent. Consequently, fans can expect to see much more of Mathers across both AEW and ROH programming moving forward.

stories.title: Marina Shafir credits Jon Moxley for personal AEW moment
stories.tldr: Marina Shafir credits her Death Riders stablemate Jon Moxley with helping her relax and rediscover the joy of professional wrestling through his valuable advice. Since aligning with Moxley in August 2024, Shafir has embraced the unpredictable nature of the business and learned the importance of having fun. This mindset led to a deeply personal moment during Anarchy in the Arena at Double or Nothing 2025, where she used a frying pan as a weapon to pay tribute to her mother and her familys immigration journey. Now, as she prepares to challenge Mercedes Mone for the AEW Women Championship at Full Gear, Shafir carries that renewed perspective forward.

stories.title: Tony Khan explains reason behind quick Jay White faction name change
stories.tldr: AEW president Tony Khan recently addressed the rapid name change of Jay White's new faction from The Last Outfit to The Cut. Khan denied that heavy online backlash forced the quick pivot, insisting instead that the original phrase was just a conversational term that evolved during creative discussions. He claimed the new name was adopted because he felt something was still missing from the group's presentation despite positive fan interest in the underlying angle. The stable features a heavy dose of Bullet Club history with prominent members poised to become a major threat in the company.

stories.title: Darby Allin explains why he values TNT Championship over AEW World Title
stories.tldr: AEW star Darby Allin recently explained why he holds his third reign as the TNT Champion in higher regard than winning the promotion's top prize, the AEW World Championship. During an interview on Going Ringside, Allin noted that the TNT title represents where he first found his footing in the company during the pandemic. He believes it is up to the performer to elevate the championship's prestige and views the belt as the ultimate underdog title that aligns with his personal values.

stories.title: Tony Khan updates AEW relationship with Skydance
stories.tldr: Tony Khan recently provided an update on AEW's relationship with new leadership following the Skydance acquisition, revealing he has already met with CEO David Ellison four times. Khan noted that Ellison holds a high opinion of the promotion, though formal contract negotiations have not yet begun with time remaining on their current deal through 2027. He emphasized a strategy focused on delivering strong weekly programming rather than aggressively chasing executives for money.

stories.title: Claudio Castagnoli injury update ahead of AEW Full Gear
stories.tldr: Claudio Castagnoli remains sidelined indefinitely and is still not medically cleared to wrestle following his recent injury angle. This downtime allowed him to make a surprise public appearance at the League of Legends World Championships. Meanwhile, the rest of the Death Riders faction has learned their official line-up and opponents for the upcoming Anarchy in the Arena match at Full Gear.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher eager to face new AEW signing
stories.tldr: Kyle Fletcher is campaigning hard for a future match against newly arrived AEW star Ilja Dragunov. The Don Callis Family member admitted he would be extremely disappointed if their paths did not cross in the ring soon. The two previously wrestled on the European independent scene in 2019 and 2020. Fletcher is confident their eventual AEW clash will produce something truly special.

stories.title: Tay Melo Parts Ways With AEW and Removed From Roster Page
stories.tldr: Tay Melo has officially parted ways with All Elite Wrestling after nearly six years with the promotion, culminating in her removal from the official roster page. AEW President Tony Khan previously revealed that Melo requested her release following her June 6 match on Collision, noting at the time that she wanted to step away from wrestling. Although Melo later clarified that she has not retired and recently expressed renewed passion for the business during events in Australia, her release makes her a free agent. Her departure closes a significant chapter of her career, leaving her future in the industry open to new opportunities.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite/Collision November 11 Review
stories.tldr: AEW recently presented a combined Dynamite and Collision double header as the final television broadcast before the Full Gear pay per view. The stacked card featured numerous title matches and storyline developments that drew mixed reactions from the backstage writing staff. While matches like Tommaso Ciampa defending the National Championship against Speedball Mike Bailey received high praise, other booking choices such as unnecessary squash matches and awkward finishes faced heavy criticism.

stories.title: AEW Full Gear Card Updates and Match Announcements
stories.tldr: Recent television events have finalized several major additions and updates for this Saturday's AEW Full Gear pay-per-view in Phoenix, Arizona. TBS Champion Queen Aminata will defend her title in a three-way match against Persephone and Maya World on the pre-show following a heated confrontation. Additionally, the full combatants for the chaotic Anarchy in the Arena match have been officially locked in with a massive twelve-person collision. The rest of the star-studded card features multiple high-stakes championship bouts including Will Ospreay defending the World title against Kyle Fletcher.

stories.title: TBS Championship Match Set for AEW Full Gear Tailgate Brawl Pre-Show
stories.tldr: A high-stakes TBS Championship match has been officially scheduled for the AEW Saturday Night Tailgate Brawl pre-show ahead of Full Gear. Champion Queen Aminata will defend her title in a triple threat match against Maya World and Persephone. This marks Aminata's second title defense since winning the belt from Persephone, while Maya World gets her first opportunity to reclaim the championship she previously lost at All In. The rivalry intensified following a recent confrontation where Persephone targeted Aminata, only for Maya World to make the save and set up this explosive three-way encounter.

stories.title: Queen Aminata Retains AEW TBS Championship in Three-Way Match
stories.tldr: Queen Aminata successfully defended her AEW TBS Championship against Skye Blue and Hyan in a chaotic three-way match on the November 11 episode of AEW Collision. Despite facing heavy offense and outside interference, Aminata secured the victory by pinning Skye Blue with her signature running kick. Following the match, a post-match confrontation led by Persephone and Dr. Britt Baker prompted Maya World to make the save, resulting in AEW President Tony Khan booking a three-way title match for the Tailgate Brawl at Full Gear 2026.

stories.title: El Sky Team Defeats The Swirl on AEW Dynamite/Collision
stories.tldr: ROH Tag Team Champions El Sky Team successfully defended their titles against The Swirl during a recent broadcast of AEW Dynamite and Collision. Mistico and Mascara Dorada overcame a grueling challenge from Lee Johnson and Blake Christian, who were aiming to add these belts to their reigning ROH Six-Man Tag Team Championship reign. Despite a scary moment involving a rough apron Destroyer, Mistico secured the victory with a clever pinning combination. This marks the fourth successful defense for the champions since capturing the titles in June.

stories.title: El Clon Makes In-Ring Return for AEW on Collision
stories.tldr: El Clon made his in-ring return on the November 11 episode of AEW Collision, teaming with Kevin Knight and Brian Cage to face the Young Bucks and Jack Perry. This marked his first appearance for the promotion since August, when he suffered a loss after taking a BTE Trigger from the Young Bucks. Clon is still seeking his first victory in the company since July, when he defeated Lio Rush on Collision.

stories.title: Brody King and Brodido Tag Match Segment on AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: The recent episode of AEW Dynamite featured a chaotic tag team match between New Level and Brodido that ended without a decisive winner. Following the bout, AEW World Trios Champions Hangman Page, Brody King, and Bandido delivered an intense backstage promo to hype their upcoming Texas Death match at Full Gear against Swerve Strickland, Kofi, and Austin Creed. During the segment, Brody King invoked his past in the House of Black and delivered a chilling line about relying on violence rather than divine forgiveness.

stories.title: Betting Odds Released for AEW Full Gear 2026
stories.tldr: MyBookie has released the official betting odds for All Elite Wrestling's upcoming Full Gear 2026 pay-per-view event. The card features several high-stakes championship matches, including Will Ospreay defending the AEW World Championship against Kyle Fletcher. The event is scheduled to take place on November 14th in Phoenix, Arizona, with champions heavily favored across most of the announced bouts.

stories.title: AEW Full Gear Facing Ticket Sales Challenges Ahead of Event
stories.tldr: AEW is facing a significant ticket sales challenge ahead of the upcoming Full Gear pay-per-view at the Mortgage Matchup Center in Phoenix, Arizona, with distributed numbers trailing well behind last year's event at the Prudential Center. According to WrestleTix, the promotion has distributed 5,728 tickets out of a current setup of 6,553, leaving 825 seats available alongside 345 listings on the secondary market. Despite a recent surge of 553 ticket sales over a two-day period, the current figures represent a notable drop compared to the 10,485 tickets moved for the previous year's show. Nevertheless, the stacked card features high-profile bouts including Will Ospreay defending the AEW World Championship against Kyle Fletcher, an Anarchy in the Arena match, and several other championship defenses.

stories.title: Adam Copeland Hints at Heel Retirement After Blood & Guts Comments
stories.tldr: During a recent episode of Dynamite, AEW aired a post-match video from Blood & Guts featuring Will Ospreay confronting Adam Copeland over his decision to surrender. Copeland snapped at Ospreay, explaining that his surrender was motivated by genuine concern for the long-term health and well-being of his teammates who have severe injury histories. He concluded the fiery promo by questioning if the locker room environment is right for him, heavily hinting at a potential heel turn leading into his eventual retirement.

stories.title: WWE Hall of Famer Attacks Nick Wayne on Chris Jericho Cruise
stories.tldr: During the final day of Chris Jericho's Rock N' Wrestling Rager at Sea cruise, AEW star Nick Wayne was targeted by wrestling legend The Great Muta. Wayne, who recently secured two victories over Jericho, fell victim to Muto's iconic green mist during a cross-over match involving AEW and TNA talent. With Muto's decisive interference, Jericho and The Hardys ultimately secured the victory over Wayne, Blake Christian, and Jay Lethal. Despite this colorful setback, Wayne continues to experience a major surge in momentum and fan popularity following his recent high-profile performances.

stories.title: Marina Shafir Pays Tribute to PAC in Recent Interview
stories.tldr: Ahead of her championship match at Full Gear, Marina Shafir delivered an emotional tribute to the late PAC, praising his unmatched work ethic and calling him a once-in-a-lifetime human being. Shafir reflected on their time together in the Death Riders faction, highlighting his perfectionism and deep passion for the wrestling business before his tragic passing in September 2026. Meanwhile, Shafir is also intensely focused on her upcoming bout against Mercedes Moné following a heated confrontation on Dynamite.

stories.title: Andrade El Idolo Explains Reasons Behind WWE Departure
stories.tldr: Andrade El Idolo recently opened up about the reasons behind his departure from WWE, highlighting creative frustrations and personal awkwardness following his divorce from Charlotte Flair. He revealed that WWE wanted to send him to work with AAA in Mexico, a proposal he rejected because he wanted global exposure rather than returning to a market where he was already well known. This led him to seek a fresh start in AEW, where he immediately made a splash by attacking Kenny Omega. Despite a surprise five-month non-compete delay, Andrade has embraced his new path in AEW as a chance to face top-tier talent on a worldwide stage.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa Retains AEW National Title, Will Defend Against Ilja Dragunov at Full Gear
stories.tldr: Following his successful title defense against Mike Bailey on Wednesday's special edition of Dynamite and Collision, Tommaso Ciampa learned he will defend the AEW National Championship against Ilja Dragunov at Full Gear. Dragunov confronted the new champion immediately after his brutal match, setting up their first singles encounter in nearly a year for this Saturday's pay-per-view event in Phoenix. The high-stakes showdown adds to an already stacked Full Gear card as Ciampa looks to ward off the Mad Dragon just days into his reign.

stories.title: Motor City Machine Guns Defeat FTR to Win Best-of-Five Series on AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: The Motor City Machine Guns defeated FTR in the decisive fifth match of their best-of-five series on AEW Dynamite to become the number one contenders for the World Tag Team Championship. Despite interference from manager Stokely Hathaway, Alex Shelley secured a last-second roll-up victory over Dax Harwood as the clock wound down. Following the hard-fought battle, FTR showed sportsmanship by shaking hands with their opponents, hinting at a potential babyface turn. MCMG now advances to face the winners of the upcoming tag team title match at Full Gear.

stories.title: Will Ospreay and Kyle Fletcher Exchange Heated Words Ahead of Full Gear
stories.tldr: Building on their upcoming Full Gear showdown, Will Ospreay and Kyle Fletcher engaged in a deeply personal war of words on Dynamite. Fletcher shockingly claimed he was the one who broke Ospreay's neck and even brought the champion's wife and son into the bitter exchange. Despite the intense provocation and a mid-segment slap, an unfazed Ospreay maintained his composure and insisted he remains on another level ahead of Saturday.

stories.title: Jim Ross Successfully Undergoes Brain Shunt Surgery
stories.tldr: Jim Ross successfully underwent his latest brain shunt surgery on November 11 after the procedure was briefly postponed earlier in the week due to positive CT scan results. Podcast co-host Conrad Thompson provided the updates, confirming that the operation went smoothly. The wrestling legend is now resting and recovering as he aims for an eventual return to health.

stories.title: Report Details Warner Bros. Views on AEW Prior to Skydance Merger
stories.tldr: Following the Skydance acquisition and planned streaming merger involving Warner Bros. Discovery, questions have emerged regarding All Elite Wrestling's long term future. A new report reveals that prior to the change, WBD executives were actually very pleased with AEW's television ratings and touted them internally. While it remains unclear how the new Skydance leadership views the promotion, Tony Khan has reportedly held initial meetings with them and walked away extremely happy.

stories.title: AEW Hires Neil Rosan to Production Team Ahead of Full Gear
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling has strengthened its behind-the-scenes staff by hiring Neil Rosan as an Associate Producer of Motion Graphics. Rosan announced his new role on social media, expressing excitement about joining the company for his next professional chapter. His hiring comes at a crucial time as AEW prepares for a special three-hour combined edition of Dynamite and Collision. This busy week of television leads directly into the upcoming Full Gear 2026 pay-per-view event.

stories.title: Jim Ross Undergoing Another Surgery Following Health Issues
stories.tldr: AEW commentator and wrestling broadcasting legend Jim Ross is undergoing another surgery to repair and adjust a brain shunt initially inserted in August to help with balance issues. The 74-year-old Hall of Famer has faced a grueling year of health challenges, including severe headaches following the initial procedure, a subsequent operation in October, and a brief hospitalization for low oxygen levels caused by a chest cold. Despite these ongoing medical hurdles and other recent health scares, Ross remains a part of the AEW team with the ultimate goal of returning to the commentary desk for pay-per-view events once he has fully recovered.

stories.title: Jon Moxley and Renee Paquette Mourn Loss of Their Dog Blue
stories.tldr: AEW star Jon Moxley and broadcaster Renee Paquette are mourning the loss of their beloved dog, Blue, who passed away on November 9 after nearly 11 years with the family. Blue was a central part of their lives, serving as one of only two wedding guests in 2017 and a wonderful companion to their daughter Nora. Paquette shared an emotional tribute on Instagram detailing her heartbreak, cherished memories, and gratitude that they were able to be with him and say goodbye. Meanwhile, Moxley and Paquette are set to continue with their upcoming wrestling schedule ahead of a major pay-per-view event.

stories.title: Chris Jericho Discusses Playing Gorgeous George in 'The Greatest' Series
stories.tldr: AEW star Chris Jericho recently discussed his role portraying Gorgeous George in the Amazon Prime Video series The Greatest, which explores the life of Muhammad Ali. Because original broadcast footage of George is scarce, Jericho relied heavily on the 1949 film Alias the Champ to study the icon's voice, Texas drawl, and flamboyant mannerisms. Jericho appears in the fourth episode to show how George inspired Ali's promotional style, and he subsequently expressed interest in a dedicated spin-off series about George's life. Additionally, a separate television project based on Jericho's own book A Lion's Tale is currently in early development.

stories.title: FTR vs. Motor City Machine Guns Rubber Match Added to AEW TV
stories.tldr: FTR and the Motor City Machine Guns are heading into a decisive Match 5 to break their 2-2 tie in an ongoing best-of-five series. AEW president Tony Khan promoted the upcoming rubber match, which will take place on a special episode of AEW Dynamite and Collision. The loaded card also features Tommaso Ciampa defending the National title against Mike Bailey, a mixed tag team match, and other high-profile segments.

stories.title: Romeo Malverde Wins Jericho Cruise Oceanic Championship
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Santos Escobar, currently competing under the name Romeo Malverde, has won the Jericho Cruise Oceanic Championship aboard the Chris Jericho Rock N Wrestling Rager at Sea. After earning his title opportunity by defeating Ricky Knight Jr in a number one contenders match, Malverde secured the championship by defeating Mo Jabari. As a free agent following his WWE release in April, Malverde expressed excitement on social media and promised to defend the title without limits or borders.

stories.title: Steven Borden Discusses AEW All Out Injury and In-Ring Return
stories.tldr: Following his scary landing and subsequent hospitalization at AEW All Out, Steven Borden recently opened up about the incident and his rapid in-ring return. Despite the concussion scare from a mid-air collision with Kevin Knight, Borden stated that he felt physically fine and wanted to face the pressure head-on. This resilient mindset led to his swift comeback alongside Darby Allin in the grueling Blood & Guts match earlier this month.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Ticket Sales Update for November 10, 2026
stories.tldr: Heading into Wednesday's dual AEW Dynamite and Collision go-home taping for Full Gear in West Valley City, Utah, ticket distribution has risen to 1,887. This marks an increase of 227 tickets sold since the previous update just one day prior. Fans looking to attend still have options, with about 102 resale tickets available and standard admission starting at $35.35. The final card adjustments are being locked in for the weekend pay-per-view during this crucial Utah event.
